title: Stereotaxic Viral Injection Surgeries for Multifiber Photometry Recordings
author: Safa Bouabid
materials: Monitoring simultaneous Dopamine and Acetylcholine release:

steps.title: Prepare and Anesthetize Mice
steps.instruction: Prepare the mice for surgery using anesthesia and analgesia.

substeps.instruction: Administer buprenorphine extended release for pre-operative analgesia (3.25 mg kg-1 subcutaneous, Ethiqa XR).
Anesthetize mice with isoflurane (3-4%) and place in a stereotaxic frame (Kopf instruments) on an electric heating pad (Physitemp instruments).
Maintain isoflurane at 1-2% (in 0.8-1 L min-1 pure oxygen) and body temperature at 37°C throughout the procedure.

steps.title: Inject Viral Sensors into Striatum
steps.instruction: Pressure-inject fluorescent sensors into the striatum of the right hemisphere using a pulled glass pipette at ~30 separate locations (350 nL per location at a rate of 100 nL/min).

substeps.instruction: For wild-type mice: Inject a mix of dopamine (DA) GRAB-rDA3m (pAAV-hSyn-rDA3m) and Acetylcholine (ACh) GRAB-ACh3.0 (AAV9-hSyn-ACh3.0).
For DAT-IRES-cre mice (RRID:IMSR_JAX:006660): Inject a mix of DA GRAB-rDA3m (pAAV-hSyn-rDA3m) and ACh GRAB-ACh3.0 (AAV9-hSyn-ACh3.0).
For control experiments: Inject a mix of mutant ACh sensor (AAV9-hSyn-ACh3.0-mut(Ach4.3-mut)) and pAAV-CAG-tdTomato.

steps.title: Perform Midbrain Craniotomies
steps.instruction: Three weeks after the initial viral injections and implants, drill craniotomies through metabond and skull above the midbrain at pre-marked coordinates.

steps.title: Inject ChR2 Opsin into Midbrain
steps.instruction: Inject ChR2 opsin (pAAV-EF1a-doublefloxed-hChR2(H134R)-EYFP-WPRE-HGHpA) into the right SNc and VTA at 3 sites (200 nl/site at a rate of 100nl/min).

steps.title: Implant Multi-fiber Array
steps.instruction: Implant the multi-fiber array into the striatum.

substeps.instruction: Mount the multi-fiber array onto the stereotaxic manipulator.
Gently remove the dura and slowly lower the array into the striatum position.
Seal the craniotomy with a thin layer of kwik-Sil (WPI) and secure the array to the skull surface using Metabond (Pakell).

steps.title: Implant Optogenetic Cannula
steps.instruction: For midbrain DA optogenetic stimulation, implant a 90 degree 100 µm core mono fiber-optic cannula (MFC_100/125 - 0.66 NA) attached to a zirconia ferrule (Doric).

substeps.instruction: Lower the cannula to a depth of -4 mm from the dura at coordinates AP: -3.15 mm and ML: ±1.3 mm.
Seal the craniotomy above the midbrain with a thin layer of Kwik-Sil (WPI) and secure the fiber to the skull surface using Metabond (Parkell).

steps.title: Secure Head Plate and Fiber Bundle
steps.instruction: Secure the head hardware and protect the fiber bundle.

substeps.instruction: Secure a metal head plate and ring (Atlas Tool and Die Works) to the skull with Metabond.
Cover the implant surface with a mixture of Metabond and carbon powder (Sigma Aldrich) to reduce optical artefacts.
Protect the fiber bundle with a cylindrical plastic tube extending ~1-2 mm above the bundle, secured with a mixture of Metabond and carbon powder.

steps.title: Post-operative Care and Recovery
steps.instruction: Provide post-operative care and allow the mice to recover.

substeps.instruction: Place each mouse in an individual cage with a heating pad.
Administer post-operative injections of meloxicam (5 mg kg-1 subcutaneous, Covertus) and 1 mL of saline per day subcutaneously for 4 days after surgery.
Allow mice to recover in their cages for at least 2 weeks after surgery.
